_drafted_note: Drafted 2026-08-23 from the world's OWN archipelago.json, README and releases. No field is filled in from memory or from what other games on the same platform do.
_platform_source: the world ships a PC apworld; AM2R is a Windows and Linux fan game
description: The fan remake of Metroid II as a multiworld.
_description_source: written by us from the structure of the game -- no text copied from the game itself
_checks_verified_note: Stays false until somebody has played it through London. Built is not tested.
_requires_source: the player supplies their own AM2R installation
_mod_kind_source: AM2R (Another Metroid 2 Remake) is a fan remake of Metroid II, built from scratch by DoctorM64 and given away free. It is not a commercial release.

client.name: AM2R Client
client._kind_source: the world registers its own client; London launches it and stands aside
client._protocol_source: the world opens its own connection to the game -- no emulator memory protocol is involved, so London carries nothing but the launch. Recorded as "self" rather than naming a bridge we do not use.

apworld._source: the repository named as repo_url in the world's own archipelago.json; its releases carry am2r.apworld (latest 1.4.6-M2)

_install_kind_source: the release carries am2r.apworld and nothing else London would install
setup: Put it in Archipelago's custom_worlds folder.
Start the AM2R Client from the Archipelago launcher and point it at your AM2R install.

patch._source: the setup guide describes no patching step

_patch_extension_source: world source not downloaded -- repo policy is addresses only. Flagged in every build until somebody reads it.

world_by.name: Ehseezed
world_by._source: the repository that publishes this world, read 2026-08-23
world_by._licence_source: read from the repository's LICENSE file 2026-08-23 -- the MIT text Archipelago itself carries (LLCoolDave, Berserker66, CaitSith2, LegendaryLinux). The world lives in a fork of Archipelago and inherits its licence file.
world_by._authors_source: the repository owner, and the account the world names in its own repo_url. NOT confirmed against a credits list inside the world, so this may name a maintainer rather than every author.

credits._note: AM2R is a free fan game by DoctorM64 and is never distributed here. The Archipelago world is Ehseezed's. Only the plugin itself is by solida1987.
